title: Supreme Court lets off litigant who flung files, abused CJI inside courtroom
description: The Supreme Court on Friday chose not to take any action against a litigant who flung case papers inside a courtroom, hurled abuses at judges and verbally abused Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant before being escorted out by security personnel.A Bench of Justices KV Viswanathan and Alok Aradhe observed that although the petitioner-in-person, one Prabal Pratap, had made “incoherent and unparliamentary utterances” instead of presenting his case, it would not proceed against him consider
